original_product.product_description_long_audience_pet_ow:
Newborn puppies have unique nutritional requirements to help support their developing senses and nervous systems. What’s more, feeding growing puppies is a strenuous task that can take its toll on your small dog’s metabolism. During the weaning period when the litter are transitioning to solid food, your dog and her nursing puppies need a tailored diet to meet their unique nutritional needs.

ROYAL CANIN® Mini Starter Mother & Babydog is specially formulated to support the nutritional needs of new mothers and their puppies. This formula is suitable for small adult dogs that weigh up to 10 kg, and weaning puppies up to 2 months old.

This tailored diet is specially adapted to meet your small dog’s high energy needs at the end of gestation and during lactation. It’s also formulated to support the healthy development of nursing puppies.

This formula contains nutrients such as vitamins C and E to support natural defences.

Thanks to a combination of beneficial prebiotics (such as MOS) and highly digestible proteins, ROYAL CANIN® Mini Starter Mother & Babydog also helps to support a healthy balance of intestinal microbiota (gut flora) for good digestion.

This formula is enriched with omega-3 fatty acids (such as DHA) to help support healthy brain development in young puppies.

The kibble in ROYAL CANIN® Mini Starter Mother & Babydog is easy to rehydrate with water, giving it an appetising porridge texture that’s ideal for weaning puppies.

Did you know that a puppy’s nutritional needs change as they grow? In the short span of 8 weeks, your puppies will need a diet that’s specially adapted to meet their nutritional needs during the next growth phase. At this stage, you can transition them onto ROYAL CANIN® Mini Puppy, available either as a dry kibble diet or with wet chunks in gravy.

At Royal Canin, we’re committed to creating a better world for cats and dogs. For more than 50 years, we’ve worked closely with breeders, vets, and pet experts, sharing specialist knowledge and scientific research to create a dedicated approach to individualised, precise nutritional solutions.

All of our products undergo an extensive quality control process to guarantee the optimal quality of food. When your small dog and her puppies eat ROYAL CANIN® Mini Starter Mother & Babydog, they’re getting a complete and balanced diet.

supplement_related_association.product_description_long_audience_pet_ow:
Support your dog’s health, one supplement at a time. When it comes to your dog’s health, we know you want to support them every step of the way. That’s why we created ROYAL CANIN® chewable supplements, so you can give them the extra care they deserve. Formulated by vets, approved by dogs.

Suitable for adult dogs, Digestion Chews are specially formulated with a science-driven blend of ingredients, backed by over 50 years of research and observation in canine nutrition. Developed by experts, these nutritious supplements are designed to meet your dog’s changing needs and help maintain their health from the inside out. Supports digestive health and balanced gut microbiota ROYAL CANIN® Digestion Chew supplements are designed to support your dog’s digestive health by including prebiotics that help maintain a healthy balance of gut bacteria, and beta-glucans (postbiotics) that support healthy digestion and stool quality.

ROYAL CANIN® Digestion Chews are a proven success with pet owners Don’t just take our word for it. When tested, 84% of owners reported satisfaction with ROYAL CANIN® Digestion Chews after just 15 days of use. * Pair with ROYAL CANIN® diets designed for healthy pets.

Our chewable supplements are designed to complement any diet within the ROYAL CANIN® range designed for healthy dogs. If your dog is on a regular maintenance diet, ROYAL CANIN® Digestion Chews can seamlessly integrate, supporting your dog’s digestive health and balanced gut microbiota. This allows your dog to maintain their existing meal routine while still receiving targeted support to help them thrive. 

Be sure to follow the on-pack feeding guidelines and give your dog no more than the recommended number of pieces per day. When giving your canine companion supplements, it is advisable to adjust the portion size of their main meal to help keep them at a healthy weight. If you have any questions or concerns about your dog’s health, please consult your veterinarian.

*Royal Canin internal study conducted in 109 dogs with mild and occasional digestive sensitivities.
